id: Jazz Festival: Thursday Late Jam-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Jazz Festival: Thursday Late Jam
long_description:
The Undercurrent will be hosting the Late Night Jazz Jam, featuring some of Aotearoa's finest jazz musicians. It will be a Koha entry and all are welcome!

Thursday's hosts: Michael Nash (piano) feat. Tyler Diprose (bass) and Finn McNeill (drum set)
